comment_text: The proposed timeline for compliance filing is practical and should improve consistency across companies.
The penalty slabs are too high for early-stage startups with limited cash flow.
The amendment clarifies annual return disclosures and reduces interpretation disputes.
CSR reporting templates are still ambiguous and need clearer field definitions.
Allowing digital board records is a welcome modernization step.
Automatic director disqualification for minor delays appears disproportionate.
Audit committee disclosure requirements are balanced and investor-friendly.
The draft does not specify treatment for legacy filings and this creates uncertainty.
Related party transaction transparency has improved in this draft.
Please provide an official illustration for threshold computation to avoid confusion.
The revised KMP appointment window is reasonable for large listed entities.
Mandatory physical verification every quarter will increase unnecessary overhead.
Dividend declaration rules are now easier to interpret and apply.
The reporting schedule overlaps with tax audit deadlines and may burden firms.
Board report simplification is a positive step for governance efficiency.
A shorter transition period may make compliance difficult for rural enterprises.
Class action safeguards are strengthened and this is appreciated.
Definitions for beneficial ownership still need alignment with existing circulars.
Director accountability language is clearer than the previous draft.
Kindly release bilingual guidance notes for wider stakeholder understanding.
Electronic minute book provisions are useful and implementation-ready.
Share transfer documentation requirements remain excessively detailed for small firms.
The revised filing portal integration proposal is practical and timely.
Consolidated statement rules are good but examples for LLP subsidiaries are missing.
Penalty interpretation is stricter than necessary and may trigger avoidable litigation.
Exemptions for low turnover entities are thoughtful and should be retained.
Rights issue disclosure enhancements will improve minority investor confidence.
Clarify whether historical defaults affect eligibility under the new framework.
Registered office verification process is now more transparent and fair.
Deposit acceptance limits should be explained with a simple comparative table.
The standardized e-forms can reduce clerical errors significantly.
Restrictions on inter-corporate lending are too rigid for innovation ecosystems.
Cost audit rationalization is appreciated by manufacturing members.
Additional annexure requirements may increase compliance time without clear benefit.
The grievance redress mechanism appears stronger and more accessible.
Please clarify if one-time delayed filings qualify for waiver under this rule.
Significant beneficial owner provisions now reflect global best practices.
Annual general meeting extension criteria should be explicitly listed.
The consultation window should be extended by at least two additional weeks.
Notice period adjustments are balanced and should improve participation.
Financial statement filing simplification is very useful for compliance teams.
Mandatory third-party certification at every stage is cost-intensive.
Director appointment disclosures are clearer and aligned with governance goals.
Clarification is required on applicability for government-owned companies.
Loan and guarantee ceilings should allow board-approved flexibility.
Dormant company process is easier now and the digital flow is welcome.
Quarterly disclosure cadence appears appropriate for market transparency.
Certain filing triggers are duplicated across forms and should be consolidated.
The draft promotes accountability and should improve public trust.
Please issue implementation FAQs before enforcement to reduce avoidable errors.
